info.description: Formatted text — paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes and links.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Text
edit.description: Formatting is available here. The attribute is not called "content", because "content" names a region everywhere else in this catalogue.

edit.label: Text colour
edit.description: The colour of the prose — paragraphs, lists, quotations and code. Headings and links inside the text keep the page’s own colour, which is what marks them out as headings and links; "context" is that colour.
